description: Turn Markdown into a clean, paginated PDF with headings, lists, tables, code blocks and links. Uses built-in fonts for Western European text; images are left out. Saves beside the Markdown file unless output is set.

input.description: Path to a Markdown file. Use this or markdown.

markdown.description: The Markdown text itself. Needs an output path.

output.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to the Markdown file's name with .pdf, in the same folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

page.description: Paper size. Defaults to Letter or A4 based on the computer's region.

page_numbers.description: Add page numbers at the foot of each page.

title.description: Document title. Defaults to the first heading.

name: markdown_to_pdf
title: Markdown to PDF
